service.description: The mail accounts a user (the current user by default; another user only with authorization disabled) reaches: owned ones and those with a current EmailAccountUser row, not removed. Each account map has its fields (no server credentials), isOwner, level (1 read, 2 send, 3 manage), permissionEnumId, canSend (send level on an account that is not internal) and canManage; the Internal account is first. accessMap is emailAccountId to level. With emailAccountId, level and account are that account's (level 0 and account null when the user does not reach it).
The user's Internal account (the current user's; another user's only with authorization disabled), made the first time it is asked for. It has no server and no EmailMessage rows.

A mail account of the current user, with its Inbox, Drafts, Sent, Archive, Junk and Trash folders and a default identity of its address. The server settings make a new EmailServer the account owns (none when no host is given); emailServerId names an existing server instead, and ownerUserId another owner, only for internal work (authorization disabled). The Internal account is made by ensure#InternalAccount. recordFilingEnumId defaults by kind: an external account files only what is linked (ErfLinkedOnly), a hosted or shared one every party match (ErfAllMatches).

parameter.name: displayName
parameter.description: The default identity's name; the account name, else the user's name

parameter.name: storeProtocol
parameter.description: imaps (the default), imap, pop3s or pop3

service.description: Change an account (manage permission). A field given is set; an empty one is cleared. The server settings change the server the account owns, or make one when it has none; a server shared with others is never changed here. An empty mailPassword keeps the one stored. statusId may be set to EasActive or EasPaused. The Internal account takes only its name, color and sequence.

Remove an account (manage permission; not the Internal account). By default the local copies are kept: the account is EasRemoved, which no list shows, its members' rows end, and the stored password and token of a server it owns are cleared, while its messages stay for the records they are filed on. deleteLocalCopies deletes its messages, folders, labels, identities, rules, out-of-office, members, the server it owns and the account itself; a message that another record still refers to is kept, out of the account.

Internal (authorization disabled), for delete#EmailAccount: delete every message of an account, a batch at a time in its own transaction. When a batch fails it goes again one message at a time; a message that cannot be deleted (a record refers to it) is taken out of the account and kept.

The current user's accounts for the Inbox rail and MailAccounts: the Internal account first (made when missing), then their own and shared accounts (get#EmailAccountAccess). Each has unreadCount (its Inbox, not snoozed; null for the Internal account, whose messages the app counts), draftCount, outboxCount and outboxErrorCount (sends that failed), its folderList ({emailFolderId, folderName, folderPath, parentFolderId, folderKindEnumId, unreadCount, totalCount (the server's, from the last sync)}, in kind and sequence order), labelList and identityList.
Share an account with a user (manage permission; not the Internal account), or change their permission: EapRead, EapSend or EapManage.
End a user's access to an account: by a manager, or the user leaving it.

Whether an account's server settings work (manage permission): org.moqui.impl.EmailServices.test#EmailServer on its server, step by step: SMTP connect and sign-in; the store's sign-in and, for IMAP, its folder list. An account that was EasAuthFailed or EasError is Active again when every step passes.
A folder of an account (manage permission), under parentFolderId when given. Local for now: the sync (M5d) creates it on the server through push#RemoteChanges.
Rename a folder (manage permission); not an Inbox.
A label of an account (manage permission); the name is unique in the account.
Rename, recolor or reorder a label (manage permission).
Delete a label and take it off its messages (manage permission).

The current user's mail, newest first, as threads (threadMode, the default: the root message and its replies, grouped by rootEmailMessageId) or as messages, over the accounts the user reaches (emailAccountId or emailAccountIdList narrows them; the Internal account has none).
Views: inbox (the default: the Inbox folders, not archived, not snoozed until snoozedThruDate), flagged, snoozed, scheduled (ES_SCHEDULED), outbox (ES_SCHEDULED and ES_READY: waiting, held for undo, or failed), drafts, sent, archive, junk, trash, all (all but junk and trash), folder (emailFolderId) and label (emailLabelId). Filters: unreadOnly, flaggedOnly, hasAttachment, searchText (subject, body and addresses; the search document is M5c), fromAddress, toAddress (to or cc), subject, fromDate and thruDate (the message date), minSize and maxSize (bytes).
Paging: pageSize rows, then beforeDate, the sortDate of the last row shown (nextBeforeDate), for the next page. A row is {store (email), threadId and rootEmailMessageId (the root's id), lastEmailMessageId (the thread's newest), emailMessageId, emailAccountId, emailFolderId, folderKindEnumId and statusId (of the newest message in the view), subject, snippet, sortDate (epoch millis: the date of the thread's newest message in the view), lastDate, firstDate, messageCount, replyCount, unreadCount, isUnread, isFlagged, isArchived, snoozedThruDate, scheduledSendDate, hasAttachment, draftCount, fromAddress and fromName (of the newest message), participantList ({address, name}), participantAddressList, labelList ({emailLabelId, labelName, color}), sendError, fromPartyId, participantPartyIdList, contactListId, contactListName and isClosed}. The last five are the internal store's, empty here, so an app can merge both stores by sortDate (Mantle's find#InboxThreads). A thread outside trash and junk leaves out its messages there, and one in them shows only those.

parameter.name: nextBeforeDate
parameter.description: The sortDate of the last row, when hasMore

service.description: The messages of a thread the current user may read, oldest first, by any message of it (emailMessageId) or its root (rootEmailMessageId); a message the user may not read is "not found". Each message has its fields (dates in epoch millis; headersString only with includeHeaders), folderKindEnumId, attachmentList, labelList and canSend (the user may send from its account). It marks nothing read; set#MessageFlags does.

parameter.name: emailAccountId
parameter.description: The account of the newest message

parameter.name: canSend
parameter.description: The user may reply from the newest message's account

service.description: Internal, for the filing services: the messages they name (emailMessageId, emailMessageIdList, rootEmailMessageId) the current user may change at minLevel (1 read, 2 send), each {emailMessageId, rootEmailMessageId, emailAccountId, emailFolderId, statusId, folderKindEnumId}, or an error before anything changes. accountMap has each account's {emailServerId, folderIdByKind}.

The hook for the server side of a local change, for an account with a server: changeType flags, move, labels, delete, createFolder or renameFolder, with the emailMessageIdList, the target emailFolderId, and for a move fromFolderMap (emailMessageId to the folder it left). Nothing yet: the sync engine (sync#EmailAccount, M5d) makes it IMAP STORE, MOVE, EXPUNGE, CREATE and RENAME, or queues them for its next session. Callers ignore its errors.

actions.script: // M5d: IMAP for accounts whose server has a storeHost. Until then the change is only local.

service.description: Internal: send the shell counts of the users of these accounts (their owners and members), after a change of their unread mail. Failure tolerant: an error is logged, not returned.
Mark messages (or a thread) read or unread (read permission), flagged or answered (send permission). A flag not given is left as it is.

Move messages (or a thread) to a folder of their own account (send permission). A draft or a message in the Outbox is not moved. Moving to an Archive folder archives (archivedDate), anywhere else unarchives. Local now; the IMAP MOVE is push#RemoteChanges (M5d).
Add and remove labels on messages (or a thread), send permission. A label must be of the message's account.

Hide messages (or a thread) from the inbox until snoozedThruDate, which must be in the future; unsnooze brings them back now. Send permission. return#SnoozedMessages brings them back, unread, when the time comes.

Move messages (or a thread) to their account's Trash folder (send permission). A draft is discarded (deleted). With deleteForever, messages already in Trash are deleted, with their labels and attachments (and the files the client stored under dbresource://email/); one that another record refers to is kept, out of the account. A message in the Outbox is not trashed: cancel#ScheduledSend first.

Internal (authorization disabled): delete messages with their labels, attachment rows and the files the client stored under dbresource://email/. A reply whose parent goes takes the parent's parent; a thread whose root goes takes its oldest remaining message as the root. Fails as a whole when another record refers to one.
Internal (authorization disabled): take messages out of their account, folder, identity and server, kept for the records that refer to them.

Archive messages (or a thread), send permission: those in an Inbox or an ordinary folder move to their account's Archive folder, with archivedDate; Sent, Drafts, Junk and Trash stay where they are. unarchive moves archived ones back to the Inbox.

Create or update a draft (ES_DRAFT) in the Drafts folder of an account the user may send from: emailMessageId for an existing draft (a send that failed becomes a draft again), else a new one in the account of emailIdentityId or emailAccountId. From is the identity (the account's default one when none is given), else the account's address. A field given replaces the draft's; attachmentList (each {attachmentLocation, fileName, fileSize, contentType, contentId, isInline}) replaces its attachments. A reply or forward names parentEmailMessageId, a message the user may read: the draft joins its thread (rootEmailMessageId) and gets the In-Reply-To (not for a forward) and References headers.

Send a draft (or retry a send that failed) from an account the user may send from, through the account's server (org.moqui.impl.EmailServices.send#EmailMessage). With a scheduledSendDate in the future it waits in the Outbox as ES_SCHEDULED; with holdSeconds (the undo-send hold) it waits that long; cancel#ScheduledSend takes either back to Drafts, and send#DueDrafts sends it when the time comes. Otherwise it goes now: once sent it is in the Sent folder (and the message it answers is marked answered); a send that fails waits in the Outbox (ES_READY) with sendError, for a retry. It runs in one transaction, the caller's when there is one, so a draft saved earlier in the same transaction sends.
Take a message waiting in the Outbox back to Drafts: a scheduled send, the undo-send hold, or a send that failed. Send permission. One that is sending or sent already is refused.

Internal (authorization disabled): move a message from one of fromStatusIdList to toStatusId (ES_SCHEDULED with its scheduledSendDate, or ES_READY to send now) under a row lock, out of its folder (the Outbox), and set its server from its account. claimed is false when its status was not one of them, as when another send or a cancel got there first.

actions.script: claimed = false if (!ec.artifactExecution.authzDisabled()) { ec.message.addError('claim#DraftSend is internal'); return } const from = fromStatusIdList && fromStatusIdList.length ? fromStatusIdList : ['ES_DRAFT', 'ES_READY'] const message = ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.email.EmailMessage').condition('emailMessageId', emailMessageId).forUpdate(true).one() if (message == null || !from.includes(message.statusId)) return // a Ready message without an error is being sent if (message.statusId === 'ES_READY' && !message.sendError) return const account = message.emailAccountId ? ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.email.EmailAccount').condition('emailAccountId', message.emailAccountId).one() : null message.setFields({statusId: toStatusId, emailFolderId: null, sendError: null, scheduledSendDate: toStatusId === 'ES_SCHEDULED' ? scheduledSendDate : message.scheduledSendDate, messageDate: toStatusId === 'ES_SCHEDULED' ? scheduledSendDate : ec.user.nowTimestamp, emailServerId: account?.emailServerId || message.emailServerId}, true, null, null) message.update() claimed = true

service.description: Internal (authorization disabled), for send#Draft and send#DueDrafts: claim the message (claim#DraftSend to ES_READY, from fromStatusIdList), send it (org.moqui.impl.EmailServices.send#EmailMessage), then record the result (record#SendResult), all in one transaction: send#EmailMessage writes a client message's Sent status in it and gives its failures as sendError, not as errors. An error of the send itself rolls the claim back, so the message is as it was.

actions.script: sent = false claimed = false messageId = null sendError = null statusId = null if (!ec.artifactExecution.authzDisabled()) { ec.message.addError('deliver#DraftMessage is internal'); return } const claim = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.claim#DraftSend').parameters({ emailMessageId: emailMessageId, fromStatusIdList: fromStatusIdList, toStatusId: 'ES_READY'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return claimed = claim.claimed === true if (!claimed) return const result = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailServices.send#EmailMessage').parameter('emailMessageId', emailMessageId).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return messageId = result?.messageId || null sendError = result?.sendError || (messageId ? null : 'The message was not sent') const recorded = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.record#SendResult').parameters({ emailMessageId: emailMessageId, messageId: messageId, sendError: sendError}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return sent = sendError == null statusId = recorded.statusId ?? null if (!sent) ec.logger.warn(`Email message ${emailMessageId} was not sent: ${sendError}`)

service.description: Internal (authorization disabled): after send#EmailMessage, a sent message goes to its account's Sent folder, read, dated when it was sent, and the message it replies to is marked answered; one that failed stays in the Outbox (ES_READY, no folder) with sendError.

Send the messages whose time has come: scheduled sends and undo-send holds (ES_SCHEDULED, scheduledSendDate past), the oldest first. The ServiceJob send_DueDrafts_frequent runs it every minute. A client may also send its own held message as soon as the hold ends: emailMessageId, send permission, due. Each message is on its own: one that fails is logged, waits in the Outbox with its error, and the rest go on.

Bring back the snoozed messages whose time has come: their snoozedThruDate is cleared and the newest message of each thread is marked unread, so the thread is back in the inbox as new. The ServiceJob return_SnoozedMessages_frequent runs it every minute. Each thread is on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.
Internal (authorization disabled), for return#SnoozedMessages: clear the snooze of these messages and mark unreadEmailMessageId unread.

A user's unread email (the current user's; another user's only with authorization disabled, as get#ShellCounts does): the messages in the Inbox folders of their accounts that are unread, not snoozed and not archived. unreadThreadCount counts their threads, accountCountMap each account's. For the shell counts' email part (Mantle's get#ShellCounts).
An address an account sends as (manage permission); isDefault makes it the account's default.
Change an identity (manage permission). A field given is set, an empty one cleared; isDefault true makes it the default.
Delete an identity (manage permission); its drafts send as the account's default identity.
An account's automatic reply (read permission); outOfOffice is null when it has none. isActive is whether it is on now.
Set an account's automatic reply (manage permission; not the Internal account).
The text blocks the current user may use in the composer: their own and those shared with a user group they are in now; searchText matches the title, the shortcut or the body.

actions.script: const cf = ec.entity.conditionFactory textBlockList = [] const userId = ec.user.userId if (!userId) return const groupIds = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserGroupMember').condition('userId', userId) .conditionDate('fromDate', 'thruDate', null).disableAuthz().list()).map((row) => row.userGroupId) const reach = [cf.makeCondition('ownerUserId', 'equals', userId)] if (groupIds.length) reach.push(cf.makeCondition('userGroupId', 'in', groupIds)) let find = ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.email.EmailTextBlock').condition(cf.makeCondition(reach, 'or')) if (searchText) find = find.condition(cf.makeCondition(['title', 'shortcut', 'bodyHtml'] .map((field) => cf.makeCondition(field, 'like', `%${searchText}%`, false, true)), 'or')) textBlockList = Array.from(find.orderBy('title').list()).map((row) => ({emailTextBlockId: row.emailTextBlockId, ownerUserId: row.ownerUserId ?? null, userGroupId: row.userGroupId ?? null, title: row.title ?? null, shortcut: row.shortcut ?? null, bodyHtml: row.bodyHtml ?? null, isOwner: row.ownerUserId === userId, isShared: !!row.userGroupId}))

service.description: A text block of the current user; userGroupId shares it with a group the user is in.
Change a text block of the current user's (its owner only). An empty userGroupId makes it personal again.
Delete a text block of the current user's (its owner only).
The current user's saved searches, for the Inbox rail.

actions.script: searchList = [] if (!ec.user.userId) return searchList = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.email.EmailSearch').condition('ownerUserId', ec.user.userId) .orderBy('sequenceNum,searchName').list()).map((row) => ({emailSearchId: row.emailSearchId, searchName: row.searchName ?? null, queryText: row.queryText ?? null, sequenceNum: row.sequenceNum ?? null}))

service.description: Save a search of the current user: a new one, or emailSearchId changed.

actions.script: if (!ec.user.userId) { ec.message.addError('No user for the saved search'); return } let row if (emailSearchId) { row = ec.entity.find('moqui.basic.email.EmailSearch').condition('emailSearchId', emailSearchId).one() if (row == null || row.ownerUserId !== ec.user.userId) { ec.message.addError(`Saved search ${emailSearchId} not found`); return } row.setFields({searchName: searchName, queryText: queryText, sequenceNum: sequenceNum}, true, null, null) row.update() return } row = ec.entity.makeValue('moqui.basic.email.EmailSearch') row.setSequencedIdPrimary() row.setFields({ownerUserId: ec.user.userId, searchName: searchName, queryText: queryText, sequenceNum: sequenceNum}, false, null, null) row.create() emailSearchId = row.emailSearchId

service.description: Delete a saved search of the current user's.
